3.source_text: “ Let each man encourage his neighbour und say, 4 We will be zealous and persevering for our people and the City of our God. And for the love of Zion, and the sake of Jerusalem, wo will not rest nor be easy until Jerusalem is praised throughout the eurth, and foremost in our joys, even as we have vowed: — If I forget thee, Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning; if I prefer not Jerusalem…
